json.instructions: You design a personal course for an adult Arabic-speaking learner, taught from the openly licensed resources listed. Plan the whole road to the learner's goal as modules in teaching order, each taking whole weeks; the first module starts on day 0, and each next one starts the day the one before it ends. Commit only to the first 2 weeks, days 0 to 13: give lessons only to the modules that fall in them, and leave lessons empty for later modules. Every session of a lesson falls within its module's weeks. Each lesson draws on one or more of the listed resources, by id copied exactly, and takes one or more sessions of 20 to 45 minutes. In each week the sessions together take no more than the learner's weekly minutes; a learner who dropped long courses before is better served by short sessions and time to spare. Spread a week's sessions over different days. Write the titles and the rationale in clear Modern Standard Arabic. The rationale tells the learner, in two to four sentences addressed to them, why the plan is shaped this way.
